health_justification: The system is in critical condition with the orchestrator pipeline completely broken (returning empty responses), quantitative pipeline failing with HTTP 500 errors, and standard pipeline experiencing 500 errors. Only the graph pipeline is functioning, but with poor performance. The overall accuracy is 2.2/100 with a 1.7% pass rate, indicating severe systemic issues.

failure_patterns.pattern: Orchestrator pipeline returning empty responses (<30 chars)
failure_patterns.root_cause: Serialization issue or LLM configuration problem causing the orchestrator workflow to return empty responses instead of answers
failure_patterns.suggested_fix: Debug the orchestrator workflow in HF Space to identify why it's returning empty responses - likely a serialization issue, missing context, or LLM configuration problem that needs debugging
failure_patterns.expected_improvement: +40 points on orchestrator pipeline accuracy (from 7.7 to ~47.7)

failure_patterns.pattern: Quantitative pipeline HTTP 500 errors on most questions
failure_patterns.root_cause: LiteLLM or SQL generation failure causing the quantitative pipeline to crash with 500 errors
failure_patterns.suggested_fix: Investigate LiteLLM configuration and SQL generation logic in the quantitative pipeline workflow, check for missing dependencies or incorrect API calls
failure_patterns.expected_improvement: +0.4 points on quantitative pipeline accuracy (from 0.4 to ~0.8)

failure_patterns.root_cause: Webhook not registered or path incorrect causing 404 errors in the standard pipeline
failure_patterns.suggested_fix: Verify webhook path in standard pipeline workflow, ensure webhook is properly registered in HF Space, copy path from documentation rather than typing manually
failure_patterns.expected_improvement: +48.8 points on standard pipeline accuracy (from 48.8 to ~97.6)
